title: Cloning Dolly Parton.
lyrics_plain:
There was a cloned Lamb,
named Dolly Parton
after her mammaries
Sheep came from mammaries
There was one bolder,
from big broad shoulders,
I called this one Yarnie
my sly Ram beau
Our laboratory,
Has told it's story
Of clonings glorious
our clones victorious
But now we're sighing
Our hearts are crying
To leave our
Gene pools of babies
Because these gene pools
will now be banned pools
Or we will be fools
They're not my banned pools,
As fair as these genes
foreign pools may be
They are just the fools I've cloned
Because these genes pools
Are not Baa code pools
nor are they banned pools
Their not my banned pools,
As fair as these genes
foreign pools may be
They are just the fools I've cloned
And now this sold Baa,
My Scottish sold Baa,
Has wandered far away
it's Dolly Parton's way
It does a duet,
as Dolly's new pet
And it will fade away,
On her far land
I've cloned a new pet,
it's a human head
And made it roll away,
A baldy sad to play
Upon a Hill's slide
a grotty Hill's slide
One of my gene pools of babies
Because these gene fools
Are not Baa codes pools
Or are I banned fools
They're not my banned fools,
As fair as these
Genes foreign pools may be
They are just the fools I've cloned
Because these gene pools
Are not my banned pools
Or are I banned fools
Their not my banned fools,
As fair as these genes
foreign pools may be
They are just the fools I've cloned
And now this cloned head
I called this head Ted
I've cloned to dozens more,
He's sold in jars by scores
Sold with all Hill's slides,
with grotty Hill's slides
You'll see a million
heads roll which I've cloned
They've seen the glory,
Have told their story
Of rattles glorious
And weeds victorious
But they will cease now,
They are at peace now
Far from these green fields of Dollies
Because these gene pools
Are now my banned pools
Or they brand me fool
Their now my banned pools,
As fair as these
Genes foreign pools may be
They are but the fools I've cloned
Because these gene pools
Are now my banned pools
Or they brand me fool
Their not my banned pools,
As fair as these genes
foreign pools may be
They are but the fools I've cloned
